Recent notes

  • SPS det4 constants on the bench: attachment does not spoil them 2026-10-11Beam testMicromegasGasAttachment

    Injection test of the SPS measurement code with the run_71 O₂ loss on and off: footprint, resistive spread and c2/c1 move ≤ 7 %. What the bench model takes from SPS, and the bench-side degeneracy that remains.

  • Beam gas attachment: the observable and one model for beam and bench 2026-10-10Beam testMicromegasGasAttachment

    det4 at H4 loses late drift charge at the same rate per ns at three fields, both views, no undershoot: O₂ attachment (~150–290 ppm). The June bench, same model, six fields: no O₂. Slides.

  • Beam attachment observable 2026-10-09Beam testMicromegasGasAttachment

    det4 at the SPS: every beam dataset loses late drift charge in both views, per unit time, with no readout undershoot; bench and discriminators.

  • MX17 papers: the two-paper plan 2026-10-09DetectorPaper

    The detector paper split into two companions (detector & performance; reconstruction with a hits-vs-waveforms comparison): outlines, work left, order of work, n_TOF tripwires.

  • A and C angles: in-situ calibration before the re-pass 2026-10-08TrackingCalibration

    The in-situ (is2) bundles close A within ±4 % on cosmic truth and read in-beam muons right to 1–4 %; production was 10–20 % steep. Before the is2_v1 re-pass: a raw-tan cut in the fit cuts C's angular reach from 0.97 to 0.58; open problems and the small checks to do first.

  • Calorimetry feasibility: what the stack can measure 2026-10-08X17ScintillatorsCalibrationGeant4

    Plastic scale 3-24 % low at the muon (fixed), liquids threshold-limited, MM dE/dx and the soft-leg energy discriminant both killed (+5-8 % against IPC).
